sn46.12:1.1: “Meditators, the dawn is the forerunner and harbinger of the sunrise.
sn46.12:1.2: In the same way, for a meditator good friendship is the forerunner and harbinger of the arising of the seven awakening factors.
sn46.12:1.3: A meditator with good friends can expect to develop and cultivate the seven awakening factors.
sn46.12:2.1: And how does a meditator with good friends develop and cultivate the seven awakening factors?
sn46.12:2.2: It’s when a meditator develops the awakening factors of mindfulness, investigation of principles, energy, rapture, tranquility, composure,
sn46.12:2.3: and equanimity, which rely on seclusion, fading away, and cessation, and ripen as letting go.
sn46.12:2.4: That’s how a meditator with good friends develops and cultivates the seven awakening factors.”
